timing: Before clean calibration or locked study outcomes
review_source: Coordinator independent source review of interval timing
changes: Trip is observed at interval end. First trip latency equals((first_trip_sample+1)-fault_start_sample)*dt, not a sample-start difference.

Commanded latch exposure counts state_before_emission==LATCHED intervals and is named total_commanded_latch_exposure_min. End-state latch samples are retained separately without calling them exposure time.
A commanded latch is distinct from actual flow cessation, especially in additional-power and residual-tail sensitivity arms.

Post-fault recovery latency is the onset of the first six-interval qualifying window. Explicit onset and confirmation endpoints are retained; confirmation latency equals onset+30minutes for complete windows. The restricted censoring metric uses onset.
validation: New known-answer timing test: trip in fault-start interval yields5min latency, three pre-emission latched intervals yield15min exposure, immediate post-fault qualifying window has0min onset and30min confirmation
